title: School and study
description: Homework, classes, studying hard, asking someone to repeat, and Mandarin versus Beijing speech.

exchanges.context: Someone explained something quickly and you missed it.
You're still halfway through your homework.
Her father praises your progress. Be modest.
You're Xiaoyu. Of course you'll help.

grammar.title: 教: one character, two sounds
grammar.body: 教 jiāo (1st tone) is the verb "teach": 我教你. In 教室 (classroom) it's jiào. Teach someone something: 教 + person + thing.

grammar.title: 听清楚: hear clearly
grammar.body: A verb plus its result: 听清楚 (hear clearly), 写完 (finish writing), 看懂 (read and understand). Use 没 for "didn't manage to": 我没听清楚 = I didn't catch that.

grammar.title: 普通话 and Beijing speech
grammar.body: 普通话 (standard Mandarin) is based on Beijing pronunciation, but real Beijingers add lots of 儿 sounds and local words. Both are fine; the app teaches standard words and points out Beijing ones.

grammar.title: 上几年级?
grammar.body: Ask a child's school year with 上几年级? Answer with the number: 二年级 (second grade).

dialogue.title: Listening challenge: Teacher Xiaoyu
